meta.description: StockHub — point of sale and quick stock lookup

403.title: Access denied
403.description: You do not have the rights needed for this page. Administration is done in the back-office.

404.title: Page not found
404.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

500.title: Unexpected error
500.description: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

kind.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection.
kind.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
kind.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

api.AUTH_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
api.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password must be different.
api.SALE_TOO_MANY_LINES: Too many products in one sale (100 at most).
api.SALE_DUPLICATE_PRODUCT: A product appears twice in the cart.
api.QUANTITY_MUST_BE_WHOLE: A product sold by unit has a fractional quantity.
api.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Not enough stock for a product: the cart was refreshed, check the quantities.
api.PRODUCT_INACTIVE: A product in the cart is no longer sold.
api.LOCATION_ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have access to this point of sale.
api.LOCATION_REQUIRED: No point of sale is selected.
api.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This sale was already submitted. Reload the page.
api.DATE_RANGE_INVALID: The start date is after the end date.
api.STOCK_CONFLICT: Stock is being changed. Try again.
